Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

τ-bench: A Benchmark for Tool-Agent-User Interaction in Real-World Domains (2406.12045v1) · paper method: τ-bench combines manually designed schemas, APIs and policies with GPT-4-generated data-sampling code, human code refinement, and manually annotated tasks iteratively checked with agent runs.

τ-bench: A Benchmark for Tool-Agent-User Interaction in Real-World Domains (2406.12045v1) · paper method: τ-bench defines pass-hat-k as the probability that all k independent trials succeed, averaged across tasks, whereas pass@k measures at least one successful trial.
